---
title: "Personal Activity Monitoring Analysis"
author: "Om Dave"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, echo=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Load dataset
setwd("C:/Users/Om Dave/Downloads/repdata_data_activity")
data <- read.csv("activity.csv")

# Convert date column
data$date <- as.Date(data$date)
# Total steps per day (ignoring NA)
steps_per_day <- aggregate(steps ~ date, data = data, sum, na.rm = TRUE)

# Histogram
hist(steps_per_day$steps,
     main = "Histogram of Total Steps Per Day",
     xlab = "Total Steps Per Day",
     col = "lightblue",
     border = "black")

# Mean and Median
mean_steps <- mean(steps_per_day$steps)
median_steps <- median(steps_per_day$steps)

cat("Mean steps per day:", mean_steps, "\n")
cat("Median steps per day:", median_steps, "\n")
# Average steps per interval
avg_steps_interval <- aggregate(steps ~ interval, data = data, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Time series plot
plot(avg_steps_interval$interval, avg_steps_interval$steps,
     type = "l",
     xlab = "5-minute Interval",
     ylab = "Average Steps",
     main = "Average Daily Activity Pattern")

# Interval with maximum steps
max_interval <- avg_steps_interval[which.max(avg_steps_interval$steps), ]

cat("Interval with maximum average steps:\n")
print(max_interval)
# Count missing values
total_NA <- sum(is.na(data$steps))
cat("Total missing values:", total_NA, "\n")
# Copy dataset
data_imputed <- data

# Compute interval means
interval_means <- aggregate(steps ~ interval, data = data, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Replace NA values
for(i in 1:nrow(data_imputed)) {
  if(is.na(data_imputed$steps[i])) {
    interval <- data_imputed$interval[i]
    data_imputed$steps[i] <- interval_means$steps[interval_means$interval == interval]
  }
}
# Total steps per day (imputed)
steps_per_day_imputed <- aggregate(steps ~ date, data = data_imputed, sum)

# Histogram
hist(steps_per_day_imputed$steps,
     main = "Histogram of Total Steps Per Day (After Imputation)",
     xlab = "Total Steps Per Day",
     col = "lightgreen",
     border = "black")

# Mean and Median
mean_imputed <- mean(steps_per_day_imputed$steps)
median_imputed <- median(steps_per_day_imputed$steps)

cat("Mean after imputation:", mean_imputed, "\n")
cat("Median after imputation:", median_imputed, "\n")
# Create weekday/weekend variable
data_imputed$day_type <- ifelse(weekdays(data_imputed$date) %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"),
                               "weekend", "weekday")

data_imputed$day_type <- as.factor(data_imputed$day_type)

# Average steps by interval and day type
avg_steps_daytype <- aggregate(steps ~ interval + day_type, data = data_imputed, mean)

# Load lattice for panel plot
library(lattice)

# Panel plot
xyplot(steps ~ interval | day_type,
       data = avg_steps_daytype,
       type = "l",
       layout = c(1,2),
       xlab = "5-minute Interval",
       ylab = "Average Steps",
       main = "Weekday vs Weekend Activity Patterns")
